Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/test/02-fibonacci.scm:
     1	;; Test 2: Fibonacci - Another classic recursive function
     2	
     3	(define (fib n)
     4	  (cond ((= n 0) 0)
     5	        ((= n 1) 1)
     6	        (else (+ (fib (- n 1)) (fib (- n 2))))))
     7	
     8	;; Generate list of first n Fibonacci numbers
     9	(define (fib-list n)
    10	  (define (fib-list-helper i)
    11	    (if (>= i n)
    12	        '()
    13	        (cons (fib i) (fib-list-helper (+ i 1)))))
    14	  (fib-list-helper 0))
    15	
    16	;; Display first 10 Fibonacci numbers as a list
    17	(display (fib-list 10))
    18	(newline)
    19	
    20	;; Efficient iterative version
    21	(define (fib-iter n)
    22	  (define (fib-helper n a b)
    23	    (if (= n 0)
    24	        a
    25	        (fib-helper (- n 1) b (+ a b))))
    26	  (fib-helper n 0 1))
    27	
    28	;; Display 20th Fibonacci number
    29	(display (fib-iter 20))
    30	(newline)
